panels.description: Cinza = sem cliente considerado. Verde = normal. Pontos VERMELHOS GRANDES com rótulo = queda recente confirmada (2+ clientes desconectados nas últimas 48h e 50%+ do ponto afetado). Inclui CTOs externas e clientes em prédios/condomínios.

targets.rawSql: SELECT descricao AS local_nome, bairro, lat AS latitude, lon AS longitude, total_clientes, offline, status_val FROM ( SELECT cx.descricao AS descricao, cx.bairro AS bairro, CAST(cx.latitude AS DECIMAL(10,7)) AS lat, CAST(cx.longitude AS DECIMAL(10,7)) AS lon, COALESCE(l.total,0) AS total_clientes, COALESCE(l.offline,0) AS offline, CASE WHEN COALESCE(l.total,0)=0 THEN -1 WHEN l.offline>=2 AND (100.0*l.offline/l.total)>=50 THEN 2 ELSE 0 END AS status_val FROM rad_caixa_ftth cx LEFT JOIN (SELECT logins.id_caixa_ftth, SUM(CASE WHEN ra.open_session=1 OR (ra.last_stop IS NOT NULL AND ra.last_stop >= NOW() - INTERVAL 2 DAY) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total, SUM(CASE WHEN (ra.open_session IS NULL OR ra.open_session=0) AND ra.last_stop IS NOT NULL AND ra.last_stop >= NOW() - INTERVAL 2 DAY THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS offline FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ru.login, ru.id_caixa_ftth FROM radusuarios ru JOIN cliente_contrato cc ON cc.id_cliente = ru.id_cliente AND cc.status = 'A' WHERE cc.status_internet = 'A') logins LEFT JOIN (SELECT username, MAX(acctstoptime) AS last_stop, MAX(CASE WHEN acctstoptime IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS open_session FROM radacct GROUP BY username) ra ON ra.username = logins.login GROUP BY logins.id_caixa_ftth) l ON l.id_caixa_ftth = cx.id WHERE cx.status = 'A' AND cx.latitude IS NOT NULL AND cx.latitude <> '' UNION ALL SELECT pr.descricao AS descricao, '' AS bairro, CAST(pr.latitude AS DECIMAL(10,7)) AS lat, CAST(pr.longitude AS DECIMAL(10,7)) AS lon, COALESCE(p.total,0) AS total_clientes, COALESCE(p.offline,0) AS offline, CASE WHEN COALESCE(p.total,0)=0 THEN -1 WHEN p.offline>=2 AND (100.0*p.offline/p.total)>=50 THEN 2 ELSE 0 END AS status_val FROM predio pr LEFT JOIN (SELECT logins.id_predio, SUM(CASE WHEN ra.open_session=1 OR (ra.last_stop IS NOT NULL AND ra.last_stop >= NOW() - INTERVAL 2 DAY) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total, SUM(CASE WHEN (ra.open_session IS NULL OR ra.open_session=0) AND ra.last_stop IS NOT NULL AND ra.last_stop >= NOW() - INTERVAL 2 DAY THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS offline FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ru.login, ru.id_predio FROM radusuarios ru JOIN cliente_contrato cc ON cc.id_cliente = ru.id_cliente AND cc.status = 'A' WHERE cc.status_internet = 'A' AND ru.id_predio IS NOT NULL AND ru.id_predio<>0) logins LEFT JOIN (SELECT username, MAX(acctstoptime) AS last_stop, MAX(CASE WHEN acctstoptime IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS open_session FROM radacct GROUP BY username) ra ON ra.username = logins.login GROUP BY logins.id_predio) p ON p.id_predio = pr.id WHERE pr.status = 'A' AND pr.latitude IS NOT NULL AND pr.latitude <> '' ) u WHERE total_clientes >= 2 ORDER BY status_val ASC

INTERVAL 2 DAY) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total, SUM(CASE WHEN (ra.open_session IS NULL OR ra.open_session=0) AND ra.last_stop IS NOT NULL AND ra.last_stop >= NOW() - INTERVAL 2 DAY THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS offline FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ru.login, ru.id_predio FROM radusuarios ru JOIN cliente_contrato cc ON cc.id_cliente = ru.id_cliente AND cc.status = 'A' WHERE cc.status_internet = 'A' AND ru.id_predio IS NOT NULL AND ru.id_predio<>0) logins LEFT JOIN (SELECT username, MAX(acctstoptime) AS last_stop, MAX(CASE WHEN acctstoptime IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS open_session FROM radacct GROUP BY username) ra ON ra.username = logins.login GROUP BY logins.id_predio) p ON p.id_predio = pr.id WHERE pr.status = 'A' AND pr.latitude IS NOT NULL AND pr.latitude <> '' ) u WHERE status_val = 2

panels.description: CTOs e prédios com queda recente confirmada: 2+ clientes desconectados nas últimas 48h e 50%+ do ponto afetado. Vazio = nenhuma queda no momento.

targets.rawSql: SELECT descricao AS `Local`, total_clientes AS `Total`, offline AS `Offline`, pct AS `% Offline`, pon_list AS `PON`, olt_list AS `OLT` FROM ( SELECT cx.descricao AS descricao, COALESCE(l.total,0) AS total_clientes, COALESCE(l.offline,0) AS offline, CASE WHEN COALESCE(l.total,0)=0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(100.0*l.offline/l.total,1) END AS pct, CASE WHEN COALESCE(l.total,0)=0 THEN -1 WHEN l.offline>=2 AND (100.0*l.offline/l.total)>=50 THEN 2 ELSE 0 END AS status_val, l.pon_list AS pon_list, l.olt_list AS olt_list FROM rad_caixa_ftth cx LEFT JOIN (SELECT logins.id_caixa_ftth, SUM(CASE WHEN ra.open_session=1 OR (ra.last_stop IS NOT NULL AND ra.last_stop >= NOW() - INTERVAL 2 DAY) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total, SUM(CASE WHEN (ra.open_session IS NULL OR ra.open_session=0) AND ra.last_stop IS NOT NULL AND ra.last_stop >= NOW() - INTERVAL 2 DAY THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS offline, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN (ra.open_session IS NULL OR ra.open_session=0) AND ra.last_stop IS NOT NULL AND ra.last_stop >= NOW() - INTERVAL 2 DAY THEN f.ponid END ORDER BY f.ponid SEPARATOR ', ') AS pon_list, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN (ra.open_session IS NULL OR ra.open_session=0) AND ra.last_stop IS NOT NULL AND ra.last_stop >= NOW() - INTERVAL 2 DAY THEN f.olt_desc END ORDER BY f.olt_desc SEPARATOR ', ') AS olt_list FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ru.id, ru.login, ru.id_caixa_ftth FROM radusuarios ru JOIN cliente_contrato cc ON cc.id_cliente = ru.id_cliente AND cc.status = 'A' WHERE cc.status_internet = 'A') logins LEFT JOIN (SELECT username, MAX(acctstoptime) AS last_stop, MAX(CASE WHEN acctstoptime IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS open_session FROM radacct GROUP BY username) ra ON ra.username = logins.login LEFT JOIN (SELECT rf.id_login, rf.ponid, rr.descricao AS olt_desc, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY rf.id_login ORDER BY rf.ultima_atualizacao DESC, rf.id DESC) AS rn FROM radpop_radio_cliente_fibra rf LEFT JOIN radpop_radio rr ON rr.id = rf.id_transmissor WHERE rf.id_login > 0) f ON f.id_login = logins.id AND f.rn = 1 GROUP BY logins.id_caixa_ftth) l ON l.id_caixa_ftth = cx.id WHERE cx.status = 'A' AND cx.latitude IS NOT NULL AND cx.latitude <> '' UNION ALL SELECT pr.descricao AS descricao, COALESCE(p.total,0) AS total_clientes, COALESCE(p.offline,0) AS offline, CASE WHEN COALESCE(p.total,0)=0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(100.0*p.offline/p.total,1) END AS pct, CASE WHEN COALESCE(p.total,0)=0 THEN -1 WHEN p.offline>=2 AND (100.0*p.offline/p.total)>=50 THEN 2 ELSE 0 END AS status_val, p.pon_list AS pon_list, p.olt_list AS olt_list FROM predio pr LEFT JOIN (SELECT logins.id_predio, SUM(CASE WHEN ra.open_session=1 OR (ra.last_stop IS NOT NULL AND ra.last_stop >= NOW() - INTERVAL 2 DAY) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total, SUM(CASE WHEN (ra.open_session IS NULL OR ra.open_session=0) AND ra.last_stop IS NOT NULL AND ra.last_stop >= NOW() - INTERVAL 2 DAY THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS offline, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN (ra.open_session IS NULL OR ra.open_session=0) AND ra.last_stop IS NOT NULL AND ra.last_stop >= NOW() - INTERVAL 2 DAY THEN f.ponid END ORDER BY f.ponid SEPARATOR ', ') AS pon_list, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN (ra.open_session IS NULL OR ra.open_session=0) AND ra.last_stop IS NOT NULL AND ra.last_stop >= NOW() - INTERVAL 2 DAY THEN f.olt_desc END ORDER BY f.olt_desc SEPARATOR ', ') AS olt_list FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ru.id, ru.login, ru.id_predio FROM radusuarios ru JOIN cliente_contrato cc ON cc.id_cliente = ru.id_cliente AND cc.status = 'A' WHERE cc.status_internet = 'A' AND ru.id_predio IS NOT NULL AND ru.id_predio<>0) logins LEFT JOIN (SELECT username, MAX(acctstoptime) AS last_stop, MAX(CASE WHEN acctstoptime IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS open_session FROM radacct GROUP BY username) ra ON ra.username = logins.login LEFT JOIN (SELECT rf.id_login, rf.ponid, rr.descricao AS olt_desc, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY rf.id_login ORDER BY rf.ultima_atualizacao DESC, rf.id DESC) AS rn FROM radpop_radio_cliente_fibra rf LEFT JOIN radpop_radio rr ON rr.id = rf.id_transmissor WHERE rf.id_login > 0) f ON f.id_login = logins.id AND f.rn = 1 GROUP BY logins.id_predio) p ON p.id_predio = pr.id WHERE pr.status = 'A' AND pr.latitude IS NOT NULL AND pr.latitude <> '' ) u WHERE status_val = 2 ORDER BY `% Offline` DESC, `Offline` DESC
